create_CocoImagesAndCaptionsTrain: create a COCO train dataset with image caption and segmentation pairs at a given size
create_CocoImagesAndCaptionsValidation: create a COCO validation dataset with image caption and segmentation pairs at a given size
use_CocoBase_preprocess_image: preprocess a COCO image and segmentation pair with resizing cropping and normalization
use_CocoBase_getitem: retrieve a random caption image and segmentation triplet by index from the COCO dataset
create_Examples_dataset: create an Examples segmentation dataset from a CSV file with COCO images and segmentations
